# Mergen Scope

> Mergen Scope (mergenscope.com) is a free, open-source (Apache-2.0), zero-upload browser workspace for viewing and analyzing Rohde & Schwarz (.dat) spectrum analyzer traces, Touchstone (.s1p–.s16p) VNA and NanoVNA files, tinySA CSV sweeps, and oscilloscope CSV/TSV/TXT captures. Built for RF and measurement engineers, students, researchers and radio amateurs.

## Full LLM reference

- [Full LLM reference](https://mergenscope.com/llms-full.txt): Detailed feature matrix, analysis tool formulas and requirements, privacy guarantees and scope notes.

## Supported files

- Rohde & Schwarz (R&S) spectrum `.dat`: spectrum traces with span, RBW and detector metadata (tested with FSVA3044 exports; amplitude-only exports rebuild the X axis from Start/Stop). Tabular `.dat` files can also contain time or frequency columns.
- Touchstone `.s1p` through `.s16p` (1.x and 2.0): S-parameter networks from lab VNAs or NanoVNA in RI, MA or dB/angle form. Views include S, Y, Z and, for two-port networks, ABCD; VSWR, return loss, group delay and an interactive Z/Y/Z+Y Smith chart.
- tinySA `.csv`: packed tinySA spectrum traces are read with sweep gaps preserved.
- `.csv`, `.txt` and `.tsv`: oscilloscope waveforms (Rigol, Siglent, Keysight, Tektronix, R&S or script exports) and other time or frequency column data, using comma, semicolon, tab or mixed delimiters via the built-in import wizard.
- Workspace `.json`: saved session containing data, panes, markers, lines and analyses (version 5 with migration from v1–v4).

Not tied to one instrument brand: any waveform or measurement exported as a text table (CSV, TXT or TSV) can be opened. Proprietary binary formats are not read; export as ASCII CSV, text or Touchstone first.

## Analysis tools

- Spectrum and RF: Peak Table, Range Statistics, Bandwidth (N dB), Ripple, Threshold crossings, Line crossings, Noise PSD, Channel power, Occupied bandwidth (OBW), IP3 / TOI, Harmonics (THD, SFDR; plus THD+N, SNR, SINAD, ENOB on FFT spectra created by the app).
- Time domain: Waveform (frequency, period, peak-to-peak, max, min, mean, RMS, rise/fall time, overshoot, duty cycle), Resample (linear, cubic), FFT (14 windows, averaging, max hold, detrend, dBV/V/dBm/density scales).
- Networks (two-port Touchstone): Stability (Rollett K, μ, μ′, |Δ|), Reciprocity / Isolation.
- Antennas: Antenna far-field analysis (beamwidth / HPBW, peak bearing, front-to-back ratio, secondary lobes) on Polar panes.
- Trace transforms: Offset / Scale, Smooth (moving average, median, Savitzky-Golay), Unit-aware Trace math (A ± B, A × B, A ÷ B with gap filling and dBm-addition warnings).

## Views and export

- Views: Chart panes (linear/log axes, box zoom, editable axis ranges), Smith chart panes (Z, Y, Z+Y grids with Z, Y, Γ and VSWR hover readouts), Polar panes, and Table panes. Up to four panes (plus experimental eight-pane layout) with linked X axes.
- Export: Publication-ready PNG, SVG, PDF, IEEE-column LaTeX (`pgfplots`/TikZ) figures, and CSV data. Clipboard copy for images and LaTeX code.

## Privacy and offline use

Files are read and processed locally in the browser and are never uploaded (0 bytes transferred). No cookies, trackers or account. The production build is a single self-contained `app.html` with no CDN dependencies, so a local copy opened from disk works offline in air-gapped or NDA-restricted labs (only PDF export needs a local web server).

## How to use

[Open the app](https://mergenscope.com/app.html) and drop a file into the workspace, or [try the interactive demo](https://mergenscope.com/app.html?demo=1).
